mesoscaleDiscussions.areas: Portions of southern Wisconsin into far northern Illinois
mesoscaleDiscussions.summary: An organized bowing structure, likely elevated at present time, could become near surface based as it moves into southeastern Wisconsin and adjacent northern Illinois. Wind damage would be the main threat. A watch is possible should observational trends warrant.

details.label: Areas affected
details.text: Portions of southern Wisconsin into far northern Illinois

details.label: Discussion
details.text: A small bowing cluster has been moving southeastward this morning. This activity has remained elevated thus far, but the airmass ahead of it is slowly destabilizing. Dewpoints in northern Illinois/southern Wisconsin have increased over the past couple of hours. The main limiter in terms of destabilization has been the cloud cover/smoke that has reduced insolation. Based on forecast soundings, if temperatures can reach the mid 70s F the storms will be at least near surface based. Given the current organization of ongoing convection, there may be an increase in damaging wind potential over the next couple of hours. The need for a watch is uncertain and will depend on observation trends.
